body: Paramjit Singh Soni (Promoter, Executive Director & Vice-Chairman) on the Q2FY25 call (2024-11-08), prompted: "my goal is to have this platform actually come to us within the next year or so" Metric: Acquisition / third product platform. Target: Platform added. Deadline: 2025-12-31 (half-year). Specificity: vague. Status as of 2026-11-19: MISSED. Evidence: Deadline (~end-2025) passed with no deal. Admitted only in answer to an analyst on 2026-05-26 (two near-misses, about a dozen targets screened). Small/mid fabrication is being built organically but is not yet a platform. Management explanation: Deals fell apart; would not overpay or buy a turnaround.

body: Sandeep Kalra (ED & CEO) on 2025-07-23 (Q1FY26 concall transcript): "we have to get to $2 billion by FY27, which is ending in March, 2027. We need a compounded annual growth rate in the range of 19%-20%. We are tracking to that" Metric: Annual revenue (USD). Target: USD 2,000 mn in FY27. Deadline: 2027-03-31. Specificity: precise; volunteered. Status as of 2026-11-22: pending. Evidence: FY26 USD 1,654 mn (+17.4%); Q2FY27 USD 487.6 mn (+7.8% QoQ, organic - Nagarro not closed). GOALPOST FLAG: on 2026-04-21 the CEO said '$2 billion by FY27, that's a run rate ... Q4 exit ... in the range of $500 million or so ... plus minus a quarter at worst' - a full-year target re-cast as an exit run rate without saying it had changed. Resolve at the deadline (pipeline v1.1: a pending original is not pre-judged). Nagarro (closing ~Dec-2026/Jan-2027) will inflate reported FY27 revenue.
